entry.title: The Pentagon’s autonomy command should draw on lessons old and new
entry.summary: As Pentagon leaders launch their latest effort to accelerate the development and deployment of autonomous and robotic systems, they can draw on key lessons from past attempts and recent breakthroughs. The former official added that Pentagon buyers should specify that the autonomy package should be modular\u2014that is, able to be upgraded as threats change and technology improves.\u00a0 关键事实：As Pentagon leaders launch their latest effort to accelerate the development；deployment of autonomous；robotic systems

entry.title: Pentagon names 4 directed-energy weapons for counter-drone program at US bases
entry.summary: The Pentagon on Monday named four directed-energy weapons for a homeland counter-drone pilot, the first systems the military will field and test at U.S. bases under a program ordered by Congress. 关键事实：the first systems the military will field

entry.title: At least two killed in Kyiv as Russia launches ‘massive’ attack on Ukraine
entry.summary: Russia’s Defence Ministry says its forces carried out a ‘massive strike’ on Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions. At least two people have been killed in a Russian missile attack on Kyiv as Moscow said it launched a “massive strike” across Ukraine. Kyiv’s mayor Vitali Klitschko said two people were killed in the densely populated Darnytskyi neighbourhood in a fire caused by the overnight attack. Russia’s Ministry of Defence said its forces had carried out a “massive strike” on targets in Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions. 关键事实：Russia’s Defence Ministry says its forces carried out a ‘massive strike’ on Kyiv；other Ukrainian regions；At least two people have been killed in a Russian missile attack on Kyiv as Moscow said it launched a “massive strike” across Ukraine

entry.title: Anduril, U.S. Navy Invest $6.6 Billion to Expand America’s Submarine Industrial Base
entry.summary: On October 6, 2026, the U.S. President Donald J. Trump announced Arsenal-2, a new software-defined shipyard backed by a $3.7 billion private capital investment by Anduril Industries. The facility will manufacture critical components for the Virginia-class submarine, adding significant new capacity to America’s submarine industrial base in support of the Navy’s effort to increase attack submarine production. Under President Trump’s leadership, the U.S. Navy has awarded Anduril a contract of up to $2.9 billion, with payments tied directly to demonstrated production outcomes. 关键事实：On October 6；President Donald J；Trump announced Arsenal-2

entry.title: Northrop Grumman’s YFQ-48A CCA completes first fully autonomous flight
entry.summary: Northrop Grumman’s YFQ-48A Talon Blue Collaborative Combat Aircraft recently completed its first fully autonomous flight. Talon Blue executed its first fully autonomous flight in Mojave, California, which included taxi, takeoff, in-flight maneuvers and landing, according to a recent company release. “Our customers made it clear they need autonomous systems that can be fielded faster and more affordably without sacrificing mission effectiveness. We listened,” Craig Woolston, vice president and general manager of research and advanced design at Northrop Grumman, said in the release. 关键事实：Northrop Grumman’s YFQ-48A Talon Blue Collaborative Combat Aircraft recently completed its first fully autonomous flight；Talon Blue executed its first fully autonomous flight in Mojave；which included taxi

entry.title: C-UAS interceptors part of new German air defence package for Ukraine
entry.summary: Federal Chancellor Friedrich Merz has announced German financing for several tens of thousands of Quantum Systems interceptor drones for Ukraine as part of Germany’s military aid package for the winter of 2026/2027. The systems will be produced in Ukraine and deployed to counter Russia’s drone campaign. The programme is part of Quantum Systems’ expanding German-Ukrainian production network, which includes Quantum Frontline Industries, Quantum WIY Industries and Quantum Tencore Industries. 关键事实：The systems will be produced in Ukraine

entry.title: Crew-12 set to depart the ISS after eighth months in orbit
entry.summary: After eight months aboard the International Space Station, NASA and SpaceX’s Crew-12 mission is scheduled to undock from the Station’s Harmony port on Oct. 7 to return to Earth. Undocking and landing Crew-12 is scheduled to undock from the International Space Station’s (ISS) Harmony zenith port on Wednesday, Oct. 7, at 12:05 UTC (08:05 EDT). Crew-12’s crew spent their last days on the Station preparing for their return, packing essential items, testing their SpaceX pressure suits, and preparing the Station for the arrival of their follow-up mission, Crew-13. 关键事实：SpaceX’s Crew-12 mission is scheduled to undock from the Station’s Harmony port on Oct

entry.title: Chris Bourg named vice provost and Barbara K. Ostrom (1978) Director of the MIT Libraries
entry.summary: Chris Bourg, who has served as director of the MIT Libraries since 2015, has been named vice provost and Barbara K. Ostrom (1978) Director of the Libraries, MIT Provost Anantha Chandrakasan announced today. “The title ‘vice provost’ signals the enduring importance of the MIT Libraries in the digital age,” said Chandrakasan. 关键事实：who has served as director of the MIT Libraries since 2015；has been named vice provost；Ostrom (1978) Director of the Libraries

entry.title: Infleqtion, Honeywell and UCSB Develop Chip-Scale Optical Cavity
entry.summary: Insider Brief Infleqtion , Honeywell Aerospace and UC Santa Barbara developed a chip-scale optical cavity designed to reduce the size of quantum sensors and other quantum systems. Blumenthal of UC Santa Barbara (UCSB), announced development of a new integrated optical “cavity” that helps shrink quantum sensors down to handheld size. The collaboration between UCSB, SiNoptiq, Infleqtion, and Honeywell Aerospace exemplifies TIA’s mission to build beneficial relationships between UCSB and industry leaders, driving technology transfer, startup formation, and innovation across diverse sectors. 关键事实：Honeywell Aerospace；UC Santa Barbara developed a chip-scale optical cavity designed to reduce the size of quantum sensors；other quantum systems
